issues.display_title: Issue #2021: Use real daily Countly time-series data instead of synthetic distribution in Support Analytics
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Replace the synthetic average/sine-wave time-series generation in CountlyReadService::buildTimeSeries with actual day-by-day counts parsed directly from Countly API's event and session trees.

Problem Statement

Currently, CountlyReadService::buildTimeSeries calculates the average daily count across the selected date range (total / daysCount) and applies an artificial sine wave variance (sin($i * 0.8) * 0.15).
As a result:

  • On days with 0 events (e.g. October 7, 2026 for payment_completed), the chart still displays 9 payments.
  • Discrepancies exist between Countly's official dashboard (which shows real day-by-day counts, 0 on Oct 7) and GoThru's Support Analytics chart.

Scope of Changes

  • In app/Services/Analytics/CountlyReadService.php:
    • Retain the raw event and session JSON trees returned by Countly.
    • Implement daily breakdown extraction for each date (YYYY-MM-DD) within the requested range directly from the Countly tree (year -> month -> day -> c, and t/u/n for sessions).
    • Populate each entry in time_series with exact counts for payments_completed, payments_failed, tours_created, users, sessions, and new_users (defaulting to 0 when no data exists for a day).
    • Update CountlyReadServiceTest.php unit tests to use dynamic Carbon dates (e.g. Carbon::setTestNow(...) or current day) and assert exact daily time-series values.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Time-series values match Countly's actual daily counts (e.g., Oct 7 returns 0 if Countly recorded 0).
  • Dates without activity return 0 instead of synthetic estimates.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly with 100% assertions.

Result

  • Pull Request: #2022 (targets main)
  • Key Commit: cb72c39cf — fix(analytics): use real daily countly event and session data in timeseries (#2021)
  • Verification Evidence:
    • Ran PHPUnit: vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Services/CountlyReadServiceTest.php -> 11/11 tests passed (92 assertions, 100% pass rate).
    • Ran PHPUnit: vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Support/ -> 7/7 tests passed (100% pass rate).

issues.display_title: Issue #2015: refactor(analytics): remove caching from countly statistics endpoint
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Remove the caching layer from the Countly analytics overview endpoint (GET /v2/support/analytics/countly) in CountlyReadService. This ensures that requests always fetch live, real-time statistics directly from the Countly REST API without caching delay.

Proposed Changes

  1. CountlyReadService (app/Services/Analytics/CountlyReadService.php):
    • Remove Cache::remember() and Cache::forget() from getAnalyticsOverview().
    • Query Countly live API (fetchFromCountlyApi()) directly on each request.
    • Retain graceful fallback (generateBaselineDataset()) if Countly API fails or is not configured.
  2. Unit Tests (tests/Unit/Services/CountlyReadServiceTest.php):
    • Update test suite to verify direct live retrieval without cache expectations.

Acceptance Criteria

  • CountlyReadService::getAnalyticsOverview() returns live data without querying Laravel Cache.
  • Unit tests pass 100% with vendor/bin/phpunit.

Result

  • Pull Request: #2016
  • Key Commits: 32268bb4c
  • Verification Evidence:
    • Unit test suite passing 100% (6/6 tests, 165 assertions) in tests/Unit/Services/CountlyReadServiceTest.php.
    • Added dedicated test test_get_analytics_overview_does_not_cache_consecutive_calls to verify consecutive requests query live data directly without cache persistence.
    • Support suite regression check passed 100% (7/7 tests, 17 assertions) in tests/Unit/Support/.
